metadata.name: Multi-Storage Client
metadata.description: MCP server built into NVIDIA's Multi-Storage Client (MSC) CLI, exposing tools to list, inspect, upload, download, copy, delete and sync objects and files across the object and file stores configured in the user's MSC configuration.

config.notes: Requires the msc CLI on PATH from the multi-storage-client Python package installed with the mcp extra plus the extras for each storage backend you use, and an MSC configuration file. Add --config and the path to that file to args to use a specific configuration.
